run_definite_pronoun_resolution: run the definite pronoun resolution dataset preprocessing script with multiple random seeds
create_DefinitePronounResolution: create a DefinitePronounResolution dataset instance for text to text pronoun resolution tasks
load_dataset_DefinitePronounResolution: load the definite pronoun resolution dataset from HuggingFace using the load_dataset method
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of input output tuples for pronoun resolution
get_train_test_lines: get train and test line tuples from the definite pronoun resolution dataset
